title: 提携解消のお知らせ
notes: Counterparty first-party notice states that CryptoPanda ended its partnership with IZAKA-YA and disabled transactions through IZAKA-YA wallet connections while other-wallet transactions remained available. CryptoPanda cited information raising AML-related concerns about IZAKA-YA; CYA records that as CryptoPanda's stated rationale, not as an independently established AML finding. The notice is relevant to loss of a previously documented transaction/off-ramp integration, not proof of platform-wide IZAKA-YA withdrawal failure or insolvency.

title: 出金・送金に関する現在の対応状況およびSNS上の情報について
notes: First-party follow-up states that no universal withdrawal/transfer halt is in place, that some reviewed transfers were completed on 2026-08-25, and that remaining cases are being processed after individual checks. This is operator-reported status evidence and does not establish that all reported withdrawal problems are resolved.
